relations.text: FICOの売上の51%(2025年度)が、Experian・TransUnion・Equifaxとの契約から
relations.text_en: Agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax made up 51% of FICO's fiscal 2025 revenue

source.label: FICO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: During fiscal 2025, 2024 and 2023, revenues generated from our agreements with Experian, TransUnion and Equifax collectively accounted for 51%, 45% and 41% of our total revenues, respectively.

relations.text: 2018年6月に英国2位の信用情報機関を買収し、英国市場に参入
relations.text_en: Acquired the UK's second-largest consumer credit bureau in June 2018

source.label: TransUnion 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In June 2018, we entered the world's second largest credit market, the U.K., when we acquired Callcredit, the second largest consumer credit bureau in the U.K.

source.label: TransUnion 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In October 2021, we acquired a 30 % equity interest in Monevo Limited ("Monevo"), which we accounted for as a Cost Method Investment.

relations.text: 借り手のデータの多くをTransUnionなどの信用情報機関から取得
relations.text_en: Gets much of its borrower data from credit agencies such as TransUnion

source.label: Upstart 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: we obtain borrowers' data from national consumer reporting agencies, such as TransUnion, and rely on their services in order to process loan applications for our lending partners.

relations.text: 審査に使う外部データの提供元の一社がTransUnion
relations.text_en: TransUnion is one of its third-party data vendors

source.label: Ethos Technologies 10-Q(2026年第1四半期)
source.quote: Third-party vendors of such information include, among others, Milliman, TransUnion and MIB Group.

source.quote: For the credit report feature available on the MoneyHero Credit Hero Club ("CreditHero") in partnership with TransUnion Limited ("TransUnion"), we offer registered users access to credit reports provided by TransUnion through CreditHero free of charge.
